skills.name: human-judgment-amplifier
skills.changes: bounded expert demand learning opportunities and confirmed collaboration outcomes into the smallest human-judgment specialist artifact
skills.trigger: delivery work needs scarce expert judgment reusable mentorship or evidence-backed recognition without personnel scoring
minimum: bounded decision learning or impact need
outputs: specialist selection and reviewable human-judgment artifact

skills.name: senior-attention-queue
skills.changes: multiple expert requests into an evidence-backed decision queue with minimum context latest-safe timing and delegable preparation
skills.trigger: expert requests or critical decisions accumulate and scarce attention must be allocated transparently
outputs: prioritized expert decision queue and delegation plan

skills.name: mentorship-case-builder
skills.changes: real delivery decisions and reviews into bounded teach-back cases with reasoning signals failure options and applicability limits
skills.trigger: an authentic decision or review can teach reusable judgment without another meeting

skills.name: collaboration-impact-receipt
skills.changes: confirmed delivery-enabling collaboration into an evidence-backed impact receipt without ranking surveillance or sole-credit claims
skills.trigger: collaboration changed a real delivery state and participants need a confirmable account
